checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film with three garden scenes
must.why: Square 480x480, one continuous shot in one garden; 15 s is met but not 16:9 or separate scenes.

must.item: Leads resemble the portraits (curly dark hair; short grey hair)
must.why: Woman has dark curls and grey sweater; man has short grey hair and grey tee. Likeness is plausible.

must.item: Woman visibly reacts with disappointment to the empty pot before the reveal
must.why: She looks down at the pot with a subdued face, but sadness is not clearly readable.

must.item: Man reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, then both place it in the pot together
must.why: The man is holding the plant by 10.6 s. The reveal from behind his back is not visible. At the end the plant is already in the pot, and planting together is not clearly shown.

must.item: Ending shows both smiling, and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Both smile at the end, but the clip has sound with a peak of -1.6 dB, so it is not silent.

faults.what: Output is square 480x480 rather than 16:9 for YouTube.
The clip has an audio track with a peak of -1.6 dB although the user asked for no sound.
Reveal and planting beats are weak: the plant appears mid-clip and the planting action is not shown clearly.
There is no clear scene structure. It is one continuous shot with camera and background shifts.
Faces are slightly soft and AI-looking, and the man's pose and hands look odd.

summary: The clip is a square single-shot garden video with likeable leads, a plant appearing and a smiling ending, but it has an audio track the user did not want, the wrong aspect ratio, and a weak reveal and planting sequence.
